in_hebrew.name: טימותי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words טום (tom) meaning 'God' and יהו (yahu) meaning 'God', thus meaning 'Given by God'

in_greek.name: Τιμόθεος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words τιμάω (timaō) meaning 'to honor' and θεός (theos) meaning 'God', thus meaning 'Honoring God'

in_latin.name: Timotheus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin words 'timor' meaning 'fear' and 'theos' meaning 'God', thus meaning 'Fearing God'
